meta_doc_type_001.evidence: AGREEMENT Between THE SCHOOL BOARD OF PINELLAS COUNTY, FLORIDA And THE PINELLAS CLASSROOM TEACHERS ASSOCIATION, INCORPORATED 2022 – 2025 AGREEMENT

meta_effective_dates_002.evidence: This Agreement shall become effective on the 12th day of April 2022 and shall continue in full force and effect until the 30th day of June, 2025

meta_bargaining_unit_003.evidence: The Board recognizes the Union as the exclusive bargaining agent for salaries, working conditions, and other terms and conditions of employment for teachers who are employed by the School Board of Pinellas County, Florida. The term “teachers” includes all full-time certified instructional personnel

meta_document_scope_004.evidence: This Agreement constitutes the official position of the Board for the term of said Agreement... The provisions of this Agreement shall be incorporated by reference into each teacher's individual contract

meta_cites_state_law_006.evidence: Part II of Chapter 447, Florida Statutes... F.S. 447... s. 250.48, F.S... s. 1012.63, F.S.
